data.reasoning: The package follows standard AUR packaging practices. The PKGBUILD fetches the source code and ONNX models from trusted upstream repositories (GitHub and OpenCV) with pinned SHA-256 checksums, preventing supply chain swaps. The .install script performs standard systemd service management (disabling services on removal) and provides user instructions. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when attempting to audit the plasma-face-unlock.install file, which forced an inconclusive verdict for that file and the overall package. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified them as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit plasma-face-unlock.install due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in a coverage gap for that file.
learnings: Implement automatic retries for transient LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent coverage gaps and skewed inconclusive verdicts.

When a model fails to review a file due to a tool error, the adjudication logic should recognize it as a missing signal rather than a security disagreement, allowing a successful audit from another model to stand.
